newsitem.title: CROATIA: Mannesmann to rebuild Dubrovnik airport.
newsitem.headline: Mannesmann to rebuild Dubrovnik airport.

text.p: Croatia hired the Austrian arm of Mannesmann AG on Thursday to rebuild an airport near Dubrovnik on the southern Adriatic coast, state radio reported.
Transport Minister Zeljko Luzavec signed a contract worth up to 60 million kuna with Mannesmann representatives in Zagreb paving the way for the work to begin, the radio said.
The reconstruction of the airport should be completed in about a year. It is vital to Dubrovnik's tourist trade since almost 70 percent of all holiday-makers arrive in the resort by air.

The airport, situated some 17 km (10 miles) outside the walled mediaeval town, was devastated during Serb attacks on Dubrovnik at the outset of the 1991 war. The cost of the damage was estimated at 175 million kuna.
It was only partly rebuilt before being reopened for traffic in 1992 with new equipment installed with the help of a World Bank loan.
